summary: Clear-screen-fade requests that ecl::CameraSplineSystem::ProcessScreenFade adds to its fade entity while a camera spline plays; drained by ecl::screen_fade::ScreenFadeSystem. Never alive in the captures.

structs.name: CameraSplineClearScreenFadeData
structs.equals: Script Extender ClearScreenFadeData (GameDefinitions/Components/Camera.h); game name eoc::screen_fade::ClearScreenFadeData

fields.name: FadeId
fields.evidence: EoCClient.dll+0xFF2C40 ecl::CameraSplineSystem::ProcessScreenFade copies a Guid into bytes 0..0x10 of each 0x20-byte element (the fade id of the request); SE name. Windows bg3.exe+0x1C9C6A0 (the game's ecl::CameraSplineSystem::ProcessScreenFade) stores a freshly generated 16-byte id (two FUN_144130d80 random qwords) at +0 of each 0x20-byte element appended to the array (count +0xC, grow bg3.exe+0x6DA440).

fields.name: FadeSpeed
fields.evidence: Same function stores a 4-byte value read from the spline request (+8 of the 0xC-byte request record) at +0x10; SE name. Windows bg3.exe+0x1C9C6A0 (the game's ecl::CameraSplineSystem::ProcessScreenFade): 4 bytes from the spline request (+8 of its 0xC-byte record) at +0x10.

fields.name: FadeTime
fields.evidence: Written 0 (upper half of the zero-extended 8-byte store at +0x10) in ProcessScreenFade; SE name. Windows bg3.exe+0x1C9C6A0 (the game's ecl::CameraSplineSystem::ProcessScreenFade): 0 (high half of the 8-byte store at +0x10).

fields.name: field_18
fields.evidence: Written 1 as the low byte of the 8-byte store at +0x18; SE name field_18. Windows bg3.exe+0x1C9C6A0 (the game's ecl::CameraSplineSystem::ProcessScreenFade): byte 1 at +0x18 (low byte of the 8-byte store; the other 7 bytes are stack garbage).

fields.name: field_1C
fields.evidence: not set by ProcessScreenFade (stack garbage copied); SE name field_1C. Windows bg3.exe+0x1C9C6A0 (the game's ecl::CameraSplineSystem::ProcessScreenFade): never set (stack garbage).

fields.name: Requests
fields.evidence: Creator bg3.exe+0x1C9D3A0 allocates 0x10 bytes, zeroes pointer/capacity/size and registers the generic array destructor thunk bg3.exe+0x5946C0 (same as ecl::character_creation::ClearScreenFadeRequestComponent). EoCClient.dll+0xFF2C40 ecl::CameraSplineSystem::ProcessScreenFade (WorldView names this component) appends to it as ls::DynamicArray (grow helper, count at +0xC, capacity +8) with 0x20-byte elements, assert text names IndexedStorage<eoc::screen_fade::ClearScreenFadeData>.

open_questions: Meanings of field_18 / field_1C (Script Extender has them unnamed too); FadeSpeed/FadeTime are Script Extender's names.
second_pass: Element layout now read in the Windows game itself (bg3.exe+0x1C9C6A0, which creates the component with bg3.exe+0x1C9D3A0 and appends 0x20-byte elements: Guid, float, 0, byte 1); it matches Script Extender's ClearScreenFadeData.
